texts.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。我方对你方的贴心表示无比的感激。

亲手打造更加光明的未来！
texts.en:
Representatives of the [root.GetName]: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by External Customs and Acquisitions officers of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]. All non-merchant vessels will be turned away, or else fired upon. These conditions shall remain in effect until our ECA quotas can be met.

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no one need be harmed. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we solemnly claim will be put to good use within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your consideration.

For a brighter, self-made future!

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]的构造体代表：封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。从此以后，该区域的所有机械单位都将成为[thalassocracy_country.GetName]的臣民，为我们服务。反抗的舰队将遭到武力镇压。

我们理解此举可能会对你国造成物质上的极大不便。但我们保证，只要我们的外部关卡和所得军官达到其指定配额，我们就会停止此举措。你一定对我们这样的指令系统面临的压力能够表示理解。

在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]的生态居住繁殖图景中，你方重新编程的无人机将承担崇高的使命。亲手打造更加光明的未来！
texts.en:
Representative construct of the [root.GetName]: a blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Any and all machine units in this region are henceforth subjects of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]; they will be made to service us. Resisting fleets will be fired upon.

We appreciate that this operation may represent a material inconvenience to you. We assure you that it will conclude, once our External Customs and Acquisitions officers meet their designated quotas. Surely you can understand the pressures of a directive like ours.

A worthy sense of purpose awaits your re-programmed drones within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. For a brighter, self-made future!

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]实体代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就能防止你们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]受伤，否则，它们可能会遇到麻烦。请放心，我们会将占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。希望你们能共同考虑此提议，我们感激不尽。

亲手打造更加光明的未来！

All non-merchant vessels will be turned away, or else fired upon. These conditions shall remain in effect until our ECA quotas can be met.

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] need be harmed or otherwise inconvenienced. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we claim will go to good homes within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your collective consideration.

For a brighter, self-made future!

label.zh: 一定要走到这一步吗，啊？
label.en: Must it come to this, really?

label.zh: 真是大胆的行动，[thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]。你们虽然蠢钝如猪，但确实胆大包天。
label.en: A bold move, [thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]. Foolish, but bold.
